summary: Aureus Greenway Holdings (now Powerus Corporation) filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026 reporting the consummation of its reverse merger with Autonomous Power Corporation (Legacy Powerus) under the March 8, 2026 merger agreement, as amended July 17, 2026. Each Legacy Powerus share converted into 599.18229 shares of Company common stock. The registrant survived as a Nasdaq-listed holding company (ticker PUSA) with Legacy Powerus as a direct subsidiary, and changed its name to Powerus Corporation. An S-4 information statement/prospectus was declared effective August 12, 2026. Watch post-closing integration, ownership split and Nasdaq compliance.
